ana: just opened a focused PR to revise the model-catalog migration checklist and tidy a couple of model-cards. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/510
ana: goals: add a compact Dedicated migration checklist, correct embed-sharding math, replace legacy curl examples with SDK v3 snippets, and pin benchmark rows to runner commit def456
ben: can you add a one-line "what changed" at the top for customers scanning release notes?
ana: added: "Catalog update: clarifies variant support, updates longcontext limits, and changes edge-quant truncation behavior (see compatibility notes)."
ravi: saw the edge-quant note 10s2; internals asked for exact behavior. maybe: "edge-quant drops the oldest KV bucket at different boundaries vs classic; apps that depend on KV retention should pin a legacy variant or use quant-compat variants"
ana: updated wording to that. thanks.
maya: embed-shard math looks good now. small suggestion: mention that tokenizer counts are model-specific and show using /tokenize before sharding
nana: added a tiny python snippet showing pre-tokenize + ceil math:
```
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
texts = [...]
token_counts = [c.tokenize(t) for t in texts]  # example API
shard = 1024
num_shards = (sum(token_counts) + shard - 1) // shard
```
ben: linkcheck flagged a benchmark CSV 404; please point to /benchmarks/2026/def456-polarion.csv and reference def456 in the table caption
docs-bot: linkcheck: 1 external 404 fixed, 1 anchor unresolved (runtime-router anchor). re-run scheduled on merge
maya: request from support: Dedicated checklist should be a 3-step runbook. can we make it action-oriented?
nana: added "Dedicated quick runbook": 1) pin model version in Console; 2) run validation on a 1% traffic mirror; 3) open support ticket to resize reserved pools if CPU/GPU mix changes
ben: LGTM. please squash the tiny typo commits and add GH issue for the runtime-router anchor rename
ravi: I'll open an issue and link it in the PR
nana: great, merging after docs-bot is green and CI tokenization examples pass on ravi's local run :rocket:
